thread.title: U.S. shares mixed Dow Jones Industrial Average up 0.21%

author: Investing.com
title: U.S. shares mixed Dow Jones Industrial Average up 0.21%
text:
© Reuters. U.S. shares mixed at close of trade; Dow Jones Industrial Average up 0.21% Investing.com – U.S. equities were mixed at the close on Tuesday, as gains in the Basic Materials , Industrials and Healthcare sectors propelled shares higher while losses in the Telecoms , Technology and Consumer Services sectors led shares lower.
At the close in NYSE, the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 0.21%, while the S&P 500 index lost 0.15%, and the NASDAQ Composite index declined 0.81%.
 Dow Jones Industrial Average were Pfizer Inc (NYSE: PFE ), which rose 3.14% or 1.24 points to trade at 40.77 at the close. United Technologies Corporation (NYSE: UTX ) added 2.40% or 2.76 points to end at 117.84 and 3M Company (NYSE: MMM ) was up 1.94% or 3.75 points to 196.95 Verizon Communications Inc (NYSE: VZ ), which lost 3.25% or 1.79 points to trade at 53.28 in late trade. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT ) declined 2.04% or 2.14 points to end at 102.94 and Apple Inc (NASDAQ: AAPL ) shed 1.04% or 1.62 points to 154.68.
The top performers on the S&P 500 were Pacific Gas & Electric Co (NYSE: PCG ) which rose 16.49% to 13.99, Xerox Corp (NYSE: XRX ) which was up 11.40% to settle at 27.07 and Corning Incorporated (NYSE: GLW ) which gained 11.07% to close at 33.72.
The worst performers were Allergan PLC (NYSE: AGN ) which was down 8.55% to 145.12 in late trade, Harley-Davidson Inc (NYSE: HOG ) which lost 5.05% to settle at 34.76 and NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA ) which was down 4.64% to 131.60 at the close.
The top performers on the NASDAQ Composite were Voyager Therapeutics Inc (NASDAQ: VYGR ) which rose 38.31% to 11.12, Trovagene Inc (NASDAQ: TROV ) which was up 26.85% to settle at 0.711 and Zynerba Pharmaceuticals Inc (NASDAQ: ZYNE ) which gained 25.26% to close at 4.81.
The worst performers were Research Frontiers Incorporated (NASDAQ: REFR ) which was down 16.67% to 2.400 in late trade, Cancer Genetics Inc (NASDAQ: CGIX ) which lost 15.75% to settle at 0.260 and TSR Inc (NASDAQ: TSRI ) which was down 13.44% to 5.540 at the close.
Advancing stocks outnumbered falling ones by 1687 to 1315 and 124 ended unchanged; on the Nasdaq Stock Exchange, 1507 fell and 1123 advanced, while 83 ended unchanged on the New York Stock Exchange.
The CBOE Volatility Index , which measures the implied volatility of S&P 500 options, was up 1.38% to 19.13.
In commodities trading, Gold Futures for February delivery was up 0.56% or 7.35 to $1310.45 a troy ounce. Meanwhile, Crude oil for delivery in March rose 2.25% or 1.17 to hit $53.16 a barrel, while the April Brent oil contract rose 2.02% or 1.21 to trade at $61.02 a barrel.
EUR/USD was up 0.02% to 1.1436, while USD/JPY fell 0.00% to 109.33.
